# runr_mcp_server (Resource)

Serves a project as a hosted MCP server at `<console>/mcp/servers/<handle>` behind RunR's gateway, which authenticates callers, forwards their identity with a signature and records every call ([hosted MCP servers](https://runr.sh/docs/mcp/#hosting-mcp-servers)). The project needs the http trigger.

The gateway key reaches the workload with a deploy: put `id` into `runr_deployment.triggers` so the project is deployed once the server exists. Needs `mcp.servers.manage` on the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The weather project (a FaaS project of the mcp-python runtime, http trigger) served at
# https://<console>/mcp/servers/weather; MCP clients sign in with OAuth or a RunR token.
resource "runr_mcp_server" "weather" {
  project_id  = runr_project.weather.id
  access_mode = "oauth"
  audit_calls = true
}

# The gateway key reaches the workload with a deploy.
resource "runr_deployment" "weather" {
  project_id = runr_project.weather.id
  triggers = {
    mcp_server = runr_mcp_server.weather.id
  }
}

output "mcp_url" {
  value = runr_mcp_server.weather.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Optional

- `access_mode` (String) Who gets in: `public` (anyone), `token` (a RunR API token of a user with `mcp.servers.call` on the project; default) or `oauth` (as `token`, plus OAuth sign-in for clients that only have the URL).
- `audit_calls` (Boolean) Also record every call in the audit log (`mcp.server.call`).
- `path` (String) Path of the MCP endpoint in the function (default `/mcp`).

### Read-Only

- `handle` (String) Handle in the URL (the project's slug).
- `id` (String) Server id.
- `resource_metadata` (String) OAuth protected resource metadata URL (empty for `public`).
- `url` (String) URL MCP clients connect to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id>
terraform import runr_mcp_server.weather weather
```
